title: Energy cost of walking and running at extreme uphill and downhill slopes
claims: Ten elite mountain runners ran on a treadmill at gradients from -0.45 to +0.45.
A fifth-order polynomial fitted the metabolic energy cost of running against gradient with R-squared = 0.99.
The polynomial coefficients for running are 155.4, -30.4, -43.3, 46.3, 19.5 and a constant of 3.6 joules per kilogram per metre.
The constant 3.6 joules per kilogram per metre is the fitted cost of running on the level.
The paper reports that energy cost rises on uphill slopes and falls on moderate downhill slopes before rising again on steep descents.

verification.note: PubMed 无正文；改读 J Appl Physiol 93:1039-1046 的 PDF 全文（Methods、Table 1、Fig. 1 与多项式回归段）。

claimVerification.note: 原文：“10 subjects were admitted to the study … They were all elite athletes practicing endurance mountain racing”，跑步机坡度范围 −0.45 至 +0.45。补充：在 +0.40 与 +0.45 两个最陡上坡，有 4 名受试者无法跑动，该两点实际为 n=6。
原文：“5th-order polynomial regressions were performed, that yielded … (R2 = 0.99)”（步行式为 R2 = 0.999），故“五阶多项式、R²=0.99”成立。
刊出的跑步多项式为 155.4 i⁵ − 30.4 i⁴ − 43.3 i³ + 46.3 i² + 19.5 i + 3.6，与 claim 各系数、常数完全一致。注：抓到的 PDF 文本层该式首项显示为 “55.4 i5”，同段步行式显示为 “0.5 i5”（通行值为 280.5 i5），两处都少了行首数字，判断为文本层提取截断，而非论文原式不同。
拟合式在 i=0 时取值 3.6，即平地的拟合能耗成本；实测平地 Cr 为 “3.40 ± 0.24 J·kg⁻¹·m⁻¹, independent of speed”，与拟合常数 3.6 略有差异。
原文：Cr “increased on positive slopes, attained 18.93 ± 1.74 … at 0.45, and was reduced to 1.73 ± 0.36 … at −0.20. At steeper slopes, it increased to reach 3.92 ± 0.81 … at −0.45”，即在约 −0.20 处最低后重新上升。
